metadata.scenario: A potential customer calls asking for the price of fitness classes at the gym. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, this is George Williams. I'm looking for information on your fitness classes. I apologize, George, but we don’t offer fitness classes at CareFirst Home Health. Oh, I see. Sorry about that. I usually go to the gym for fitness. No problem at all! We specialize in home healthcare services like nursing and therapy. Right, I remember. I’ve been a client for cardiac care. Yes, you've been with us for about seven months now. How have you been feeling? Actually, I've been doing well, thanks for asking! That's great to hear! Is there anything specific you'd like to know about our services? Well, now that you mention it, how much do you charge for cardiac care monitoring? Cardiac care monitoring is priced at $80 to $100 for a session lasting about 45 to 60 minutes. That sounds reasonable. Could you remind me what that includes? Sure! It includes vital sign monitoring and management of your cardiac condition. Perfect. I’d like to continue those sessions. When’s the next available appointment? Let me check the schedule for our registered nurse, Robert. One moment, please. Of course. It looks like Robert is available this Tuesday at 10 AM or 2 PM. Could you book me for the 10 AM slot? Absolutely, I’ve booked you for Tuesday at 10 AM with Robert. Thank you! That’s very helpful. You're welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Not right now. I’m just glad to get these appointments scheduled. Great! Just a quick note—if you're ever interested in our other services, feel free to ask. I might do that. I’ve been thinking about physical therapy for mobility. Our physical therapy sessions are priced around $110 to $140, depending on the service. I’ll keep that in mind for the future. Perfect! I’ll follow up after your next visit to see how you're doing. Sounds good! Thank you again, Margaret. Thank you, George! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
